en.title: Check and fill a save from the shape of its defaults
en.body: shapeOf(defaults, rules) of @egret/engine/kit gives a save store's validate from the shape of a game's defaults: it fills the fields an older save lacks and holds the data to the defaults' types and to rules by path (allowed values, a range, or a check). Twelve games of the games repository wrote this by hand. The guide's list of resolved engine notes gains the save and UI fixes of #424.

zh.title: 按默认值的形状检查并补全存档
zh.body: @egret/engine/kit 新增 shapeOf(defaults, rules)，按游戏默认值的形状生成存档库的 validate：先给旧存档补上缺少的字段，再按默认值的类型和按路径写的规则（允许的值、范围或自定义检查）检查数据。游戏仓库里有十二个游戏是手写这段代码的。指南的已解决引擎笔记清单补上了 #424 的存档和界面修复。
